title: Watching Watergate hearings at the Gold Key Motel as F. Lee Bailey makes a pay-phone call

tellings.quote: I was sitting in the goldkey motel mhm with my investigator the William Johnstone Taylor

plain: In 1973, a lawyer named Dan Sheehan sat in the Gold Key Motel in Washington with his investigator, William Johnstone Taylor, watching the Watergate hearings while the famous defence lawyer F. Lee Bailey made a call from a pay phone. Sheehan tells Michels this from his own memory: "I was sitting in the goldkey motel with my investigator the William Johnstone Taylor." He tells it as part of how he found himself close to the inside of the Watergate affair.
